name: gangway
description: Charts, diagrams, documents, decks and canvases on a real HTTPS URL on your own gangway server, in place of built-in artifacts; and a quick place to put up new apps, with a database if they need one.

interface.shortDescription: Charts, diagrams, docs and decks at a real URL
interface.longDescription: The generate-artifact skill: whenever you would draw a chart or a diagram, or make a document, a deck or a canvas, build it from gangway's templates at a real URL on your own server; and offer a URL for a new app once it runs. Connect the MCP server separately: codex mcp add gangway --url https://mcp.<your base>/ then codex mcp login gangway.
defaultPrompt: Make a diagram of this app's infrastructure
Build a small app and deploy it to gangway
